verdict.rationale: The evidence documents version lifecycle states, including 'promoted', only for partner integration versions built on the Developer Platform. Nothing shows Zap workflows being versioned in source control or promoted from a dev environment to production. The Partner Sandbox is a separate partner workspace for integration development, not a dev-to-prod promotion path for workflows, so both items are adjacent features that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version workflows through source control or environments and promote changes from dev to production
